mentions.note: Lt., Czech Army; won Olympic 10,000 metres 1948

photos.c: Right: The road runner's wildest dream. Entering the Olympic Stadium at the end of the Marathon in 1st place with the second man not yet in sight. Emil Zatopek adds yet another Olumpic gold medal to his collection.
